name: Bender
ethnicity_note: Ethnic composition from Transnistria's own 2015 census, the Bender city council's row, as pop-stat.mashke.org compiles it. Moldova's 2024 census did not count Bender; this is the breakaway authority's count, not Moldova's.

inputs: Transnistria's 2015 census, ethnic composition by district, as pop-stat.mashke.org compiles it: Bender
Biroul Național de Statistică, Recensământul Populației și Locuințelor 2024, annex tables 5.33 and 5.35 (by ethnicity)
religion.note: Not read: no census that counted Bender has published its religious affiliation. Modelled from its ethnic composition in Transnistria's 2015 census, each group given the religious affiliation its members declared in Moldova's 2024 census. Assumes the left bank's Russians, Ukrainians and Moldovans answer as the right bank's do; the left bank is more Russian-speaking, so this understates Russian. People whose ethnicity was not recorded are given the declared mix.

inputs: Transnistria's 2015 census, ethnic composition by district, as pop-stat.mashke.org compiles it: mun tiraspol
Transnistria's 2015 census, ethnic composition by district, as pop-stat.mashke.org compiles it: or dnestrovsc
Transnistria's 2015 census, ethnic composition by district, as pop-stat.mashke.org compiles it: grigoriopol
Transnistria's 2015 census, ethnic composition by district, as pop-stat.mashke.org compiles it: dubasari
Transnistria's 2015 census, ethnic composition by district, as pop-stat.mashke.org compiles it: camenca
Transnistria's 2015 census, ethnic composition by district, as pop-stat.mashke.org compiles it: ribnita
Transnistria's 2015 census, ethnic composition by district, as pop-stat.mashke.org compiles it: slobozia
ethnicity.note: Not read as one figure: the sum of Transnistria's seven left-bank rows of its own 2015 census, which is the republic's total less Bender. Its Slobozia district also counts three communes on the right bank (Chițcani, Cremenciug, Gîsca) that the map draws in Căușeni, so the sum is of a slightly larger area than this shape. Breakaway authority's census; Moldova's 2024 census did not count this territory.
